name: Gabriel
message:
I had the pleasure of working alongside Felipe and consistently admired both his technical skills and professional attitude. He is a highly reliable engineer who approaches challenges with a problem-solving mindset, writes clean and maintainable code, and always strives to deliver high-quality solutions.

Beyond his technical expertise, Felipe is someone you can trust to handle responsibilities with professionalism, integrity, and dedication. Any team would be fortunate to have him, and I would gladly work with him again in the future.
